mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the cover was most worthwhile because it brought together the different needs of the tubers, shoots and roots.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making and then fitting the cover were fairly predictable once their purpose was clear, though the separate fitting was straightforward.

surprise.text: I found the distinction between shoots growing above the surface and new tubers forming below it useful.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the foil and fabric combination was initially a guess, but its purpose became clear.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see how the crops develop and whether the potatoes eventually get tasted; the planting made that wait feel tangible.
